append.detail: Built 2026-11-09 from the draft Daniel approved at 18:28Z. lib/themes/library.ts reads the theme manifests (themeCatalogFacts: surface readiness from the manifest library entry, both registers from a supported register dial); the /themes kit bar gains Register (Night, Day, Both) and Ready (Website, Spotlight, Email, Space) filters that read those facts first and the card second (kit-showcase/filters.ts, pinned by filters.test.ts), and a 'Your site is on <theme> · see it' chip fed by a server action (app/(marketing)/themes/actions.ts) so the static page stays static. Role coverage filters wait on the role manifests (every role still 'missing'). The editor picker is unchanged.
